question: Combien de produits differents vendons-nous ?

question: Quel est le prix moyen, median et maximum d'un article vendu ?
sql_reference:

       ROUND(MEDIAN(price), 2) AS prix_median,
       ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS prix_max

question: Quelle est la note moyenne donnee par nos clients ?

question: Combien d'articles vendons-nous en moyenne par commande ?

question: Quel est le montant total des frais de port factures ?

question: Quel est le poids moyen d'un produit, en excluant ceux dont le poids est inconnu ?

question: Combien de commandes comportent plus d'un article ?
Quels sont les cinq etats bresiliens qui comptent le plus de clients ?
Quels sont les dix produits les plus vendus, en nombre d'articles ?
Quelles sont les dix categories de produits qui rapportent le plus, en euros ?
sql_reference:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quels sont les cinq vendeurs qui realisent le plus gros chiffre d'affaires ?
Quelles sont les dix villes qui commandent le plus ?
sql_reference:
SELECT c.customer_city AS ville, COUNT(*) AS commandes
FROM entrepot.orders AS o
JOIN entrepot.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY commandes DESC, ville ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Quels sont les cinq moyens de paiement les plus utilises ?
Quelles sont les cinq categories dont le panier moyen par article est le plus eleve, parmi celles vendues au moins cent fois ?
sql_reference:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(i.price), 2) AS prix_moyen
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC LIMIT 5;
piege: Sans le seuil de cent ventes, le classement est domine par des categories marginales.
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(i.price), 2) AS prix_moyen,
       COUNT(*) AS articles
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Quels sont les dix clients qui ont depense le plus au total ?
sql_reference:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS depense_totale
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY depense_totale DESC LIMIT 10;
piege: Regrouper sur customer_unique_id, pas customer_id.

question: Quelles sont les cinq categories qui recoivent les plus mauvaises notes, parmi celles evaluees au moins deux cents fois ?
sql_reference:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne
FROM entrepot.order_reviews AS r
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY note_moyenne ASC LIMIT 5;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne,
       COUNT(*) AS avis
FROM entrepot.order_reviews AS r
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL

question: Quels sont les cinq etats ou le panier moyen est le plus eleve ?
sql_reference:
SELECT c.customer_state AS etat, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS panier_moyen
FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM entrepot.order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS t
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN entrepot.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Quels sont les trois statuts de commande les plus frequents ?
Combien de commandes par mois en 2017 ?

FROM entrepot.orders
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017

piege: order_purchase_timestamp est un VARCHAR : conversion obligatoire.

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?
sql_reference:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS mois,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot.orders AS o
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018

question: Combien de commandes par annee ?
Quel jour de la semaine recoit le plus de commandes ?
A quelle heure de la journee nos clients commandent-ils le plus ?
Quelle a ete l'evolution du panier moyen trimestre par trimestre ?
sql_reference:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS trimestre,
       ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS panier_moyen
FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM entrepot.order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS t
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Le delai de livraison s'est-il degrade au fil des mois de 2018 ?
sql_reference:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS mois,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
              TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
              TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot.orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
piege: Les commandes sans date de livraison doivent etre exclues, pas comptees a zero.

question: Quelle est la progression du nombre de commandes entre 2017 et 2018, en pourcentage ?
sql_reference:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS progression_pct
FROM entrepot.orders;
piege: 2018 est une annee tronquee : la comparaison brute est trompeuse.
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commandes_2017,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commandes_2018,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS progression_pct
FROM entrepot.orders;

question: Combien de commandes par mois en 2018, uniquement celles livrees ?

       COUNT(*) AS commandes_livrees
FROM entrepot.orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018

question: Quel chiffre d'affaires par etat du client ?
sql_reference:
SELECT c.customer_state AS etat, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
sql_reference:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(i.price), 2) AS prix_moyen
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot.product_category_name_translation AS t
  ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(i.price), 2) AS prix_moyen
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot.product_category_name_translation AS t
  ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
sql_reference:
SELECT s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
              TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
              TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.sellers AS s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
              TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
              TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours,
       COUNT(*) AS commandes
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.sellers AS s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC;

question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
sql_reference:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne
FROM entrepot.order_reviews AS r
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot.product_category_name_translation AS t
  ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne, COUNT(*) AS avis
FROM entrepot.order_reviews AS r
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot.product_category_name_translation AS t
  ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;

question: Quel est le montant moyen paye par type de paiement ?

question: Les commandes payees en plusieurs fois sont-elles plus cheres ?
Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par etat du vendeur et par annee ?
sql_reference:
SELECT s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
       EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.sellers AS s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id

question: Combien de commandes un vendeur traite-t-il en moyenne ?
Les clients qui achetent cher mettent-ils de meilleures notes ?
sql_reference:
SELECT CASE WHEN t.total >= 200 THEN 'panier eleve' ELSE 'panier modeste' END AS segment,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne
FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM entrepot.order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS t
JOIN entrepot.order_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
SELECT CASE WHEN t.total >= 200 THEN 'panier eleve' ELSE 'panier modeste' END AS segment,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne, COUNT(*) AS avis
FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM entrepot.order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS t
JOIN entrepot.order_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;

question: Quelle part du chiffre d'affaires les frais de port representent-ils, par etat ?
sql_reference:
SELECT c.customer_state AS etat,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.freight_value) / NULLIF(SUM(i.price + i.freight_value), 0), 2) AS part_frais_port_pct
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY part_frais_port_pct DESC;

question: Quels vendeurs vendent dans le plus grand nombre de categories differentes ?

question: Combien de commandes sont livrees dans un etat different de celui du vendeur ?

FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id

question: Les clients qui laissent un commentaire mettent-ils de moins bonnes notes que ceux qui n'en laissent pas ?

            THEN 'sans message' ELSE 'avec message' END AS groupe,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne

       COALESCE(c.n, 0) - COALESCE(s.n, 0) AS ecart

  ON s.seller_state = c.customer_state

FROM (SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM entrepot.customers GROUP BY customer_state) AS c

question: Quelle categorie a le plus progresse en chiffre d'affaires entre 2017 et 2018 ?
sql_reference:
WITH ca AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
         EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
         SUM(i.price) AS montant
  FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
  JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT categorie,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN annee = 2018 THEN montant ELSE -montant END), 2) AS progression
FROM ca GROUP BY categorie ORDER BY progression DESC;
sql_reference_avant_audit:
WITH ca AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
         EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
         SUM(i.price) AS montant
  FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
  JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT categorie,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN annee = 2017 THEN montant ELSE 0 END), 2) AS ca_2017,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN annee = 2018 THEN montant ELSE 0 END), 2) AS ca_2018,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN annee = 2018 THEN montant ELSE -montant END), 2) AS progression
FROM ca GROUP BY categorie ORDER BY progression DESC LIMIT 5;
